assertions: All currently represented Font values survive real SwDoc numbering and structured-clone transport.
One reusable browser codec restores actual native values with strict primitive admission and native-default legacy handling.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task183 repairs loss of new represented native Font paint/alignment/size fields in Writer browser document/Worker records. One shared vcl/browser metadata codec transports actual Font values using existing Color/Size owners;Writer keeps its existing family-name/presence ownership fields and delegates metadata encode/restore. Complete current groups preserve packed alpha colors,independent transparency,alignment and signed safe-integer geometry. Validation rejects malformed/partial new groups before mutating the actual Font;legacy four-field metadata restores absent new values from a genuine default Font at the existing browser I/O boundary. Fill precedes explicit transparency to preserve native independent flags. Core Font/Color/Size/numbering and ODF algorithms remain unchanged. This is browser primitive transport,not a native wire format,service or class facsimile. Full unrepresented Font/config/device/rendering and actual Calc pool/document/UI/same-model ODS remain pending;registered save/open/recovery deviations and broad parity statuses are preserved.

record.capability: Lossless shared Font metadata through Writer Worker transport
gaps: Font fields outside the current shared owner,configuration/device/rendering remain pending.
Browser records are not native serialized Font bytes or services.
